evaluation.runner: stages.calibration_volume.dose_driver.evaluate_all (fluid via run_battery --mode eval, the capability and legacy units via uncapped_eval; scored by shared.evaluation.eval_set_scoring)
evaluation.progress: <durable root>/<unit>/eval_progress: finished generation files, rescored rather than regenerated on a restart (evaluate_all's own mechanism)

order: persist_unit files label training (config, trainer log and manifests)
persist_unit files label evaluation (generations, rows, formal report, logs; logical paths)
durability.state_from: the durable root only: a completed report record = completed and scored (skip, bring the evidence home, never the weights); a completed checkpoint record without one = trained and durable (re-verify, resume at scoring, never retrain); none = not trained (train); a record whose inputs differ from this unit's = identity mismatch (preserve, consume nothing, stop)
durability.local_trained_model: a model a previous attempt on THIS machine finished training (trained.json in its attempt directory, inputs equal) is persisted rather than retrained
durability.capacity: --capacity-bytes (the provider's figure less what is there); df is not a network volume's quota

retry.endpoint: one complete endpoint per unit: a completed checkpoint is never overwritten and a scored unit is never rerun
retry.after_formal_training_began: an engineering failure is repaired and the SAME unit and seed retrained from the initialization as one replacement endpoint; the failed attempt is preserved in its own attempt directory and listed; partial measurements are never pooled
retry.attempts: <durable root>/<unit>/attempts.jsonl, append-only: run id, git commit, state at start, action, replacement_of, outcome, stage, error and its failure signature (aadistill.infrastructure.failure_signature) for the launcher's same-failure gate
retry.on_failure: the driver stops at the first failed unit (later units would meet the same defect); every earlier completed unit is already persisted

training_resume.why: train_stage3.py has --resume, but whether a resumed run equals an uninterrupted one (data order, RNG, optimizer state) is a GPU-validation question; until that is shown a failed training attempt is retrained from the initialization

validation.namespace: <durable root>/validation/<unit>: never the formal namespace, and its report says formal: false
validation.may: run a provisional schedule or reduced steps (the lr rule recomputed for N); it may not run a pending pack

boundary.teardown: the launcher's: this driver creates, stops and deletes no provider resource
boundary.observers: the driver starts no background watcher; its children run to completion (subprocess.run), and the terminal path records an empty watch set
boundary.terminal: --status gets ALL_DONE, FAILED or REFUSED with the per-unit outcome, in the same code path that ends the run

left_to_gpu_validation: real CUDA execution of train_stage3 on the derived recipe at 7 and 2 blocks per step
